Part 11 of the "Shitty JPG-set from the early internet that after all these years noone's still bothered to rip properly" CG series.

Animated section is 36-88, every other pic or so. Rather than the usual 256 color GIFs for the gallery and higher quality WEBMs in the torrent this is my first attempt at making animated WEBPs. The format is rightfully not as widely accepted but seems to produce much more accurate frames with details and color preserved in a lightweight file. Most likely I'll stick to it going forward, unless there's some downsides that I just haven't noticed yet.
